settings.name: WHITELIST_COUNTRY
settings.description: **Country Whitelist:** List of country codes and/or country-group tokens separated by spaces. Only these countries are allowed.

settings.name: BLACKLIST_COUNTRY
settings.description: **Country Blacklist:** List of country codes and/or country-group tokens separated by spaces. These countries are blocked.

settings.name: COUNTRY_IGNORE_URI
settings.description: **Ignored URI:** List of URI regex patterns separated by spaces that should bypass country checks. Patterns are checked against the path and the full request URI with query string.

settings.name: COUNTRY_IGNORE_HEADER_NAME
settings.description: **Header name:** Name of a request header that makes the request bypass the country check. Numbered pairs: `_NAME_1` goes with `_VALUE_1`.

settings.name: COUNTRY_IGNORE_HEADER_VALUE
settings.description: **Header value:** PCRE regex the header value must match. Leave empty to match on the header being present, whatever it carries.
